objective: Independently validate the pre-defined deterioration semantics on later filing quarters and issue a hard Fundamental V2 research decision without training or promotion.
primary_comparison: PURE_DETERIORATION future stock returns versus PURE_IMPROVEMENT future stock returns.
horizon_eligibility: At least 30 mature events in each primary cohort for the horizon.
directional_support_rule: Both mean and median forward return of PURE_DETERIORATION must be below PURE_IMPROVEMENT.
final_decision_rules: If official-price matched-event coverage is below 75%, DO_NOT_PROMOTE_INSUFFICIENT_OFFICIAL_PRICE_COVERAGE.
If no OOS horizon has >=30 mature observations in both cohorts, DO_NOT_PROMOTE_INSUFFICIENT_MATURE_OOS.
If at least two eligible OOS horizons all satisfy the directional support rule and development evidence is not directionally contradictory, classify VALIDATED_RISK_FILTER_CANDIDATE_SHADOW_ONLY.
If at least one eligible OOS horizon supports but the full validation rule is not met, classify PROMISING_RISK_FILTER_CANDIDATE_NOT_VALIDATED.
caveats: This is a fixed descriptive validation, not statistical-significance proof.
No horizon, feature, or threshold is optimized after observing outcomes.
No production promotion is authorized by this research close.
